இலைகள் ஊதா நிறமா மாறுது, வளர்ச்சி மெதுவா இருக்கு
frost burnt the top leaves during the cold night
goats ate the leaves and some stems are broken
leaves turned yellow and twisted after weedicide was sprayed in the next field
the fruits cracked open after heavy rain
white bleached patches on the fruits facing the sun
leaf edges are brown and scorched like potassium deficiency
hailstones tore the leaves and bruised the fruits
plants are leaning because the stakes fell in the wind
